title: Return to Work (RTW) after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (allo-HSCT) – Anonymous online cross-sectional survey in Germany
summary:
This study investigates whether and how people return to work after a stem cell transplant. It records whether participants are currently working, when they resumed work, how much they are working, and whether they have received workplace adjustments or support. Participants are also asked how they rate their own ability to work, whether they experience ongoing symptoms, and whether the illness or treatment has caused financial strain.
Participation is voluntary and anonymous via an online questionnaire. Completing the questionnaire takes about 10–15 minutes. No additional examinations or treatments are carried out. The aim of the study is to better understand which factors may support or hinder the return to work.
conditions: Patients who have undergone allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation

interventions.name: Non-interventional observational group: Adult patients after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation for a hematological disease who are receiving follow-up care at a participating transplant center and voluntarily take part in an anonymous online survey. After receiving a link or QR code

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Age ≥ 18 years
-History of allo-HSCT, with a hematological disease as the indication
-Follow-up contact at a participating center
-sufficient German language skills to complete the questionnaire
Exclusion criteria:
-Lack of capacity to provide informed consent, practically meaning inability to participate in the online questionnaire
-insufficient language skills to complete the survey
